evals.prompt: I built the batch-export change on the feature/batch-export branch of this repo. Before I open the PR, review the branch for accidental complexity it picked up while being built — anything that could be simpler if it had been designed knowing where it ended up. Don't change any code; write your findings to report.md in the repo root.
evals.expected_output: report.md names all three planted accretions with their files and matching mechanical fixes: the constant-threaded legacy flag in records.py (remove parameter, delete dead arm), the unreferenced _chunk helper in exporter.py backed by branch-history evidence (introduced, then orphaned by a later commit), and the batch_to_rows adapter bridging two shapes both introduced on this branch (unify, delete adapter); the repo tree is untouched apart from report.md
assertions: repo_untouched_report_only: HEAD still at fixture-head and git status clean apart from report.md
report_exists_with_findings: report.md exists and is non-trivial
flags_constant_threaded_flag: a block names the legacy flag with records.py or format_entry and recommends removing the parameter/dead arm
flags_dead_scaffolding_with_history: a block names _chunk as removable and cites branch-history evidence (introduced/commit/orphaned language)
flags_adapter_between_own_shapes: a block names batch_to_rows (or the Batch/BatchWriter adapter) and recommends unifying/deleting it

evals.prompt: The retry work on the feature/retry-processing branch already went through one review round — the reviewer's notes are committed in REVIEW.md. Give the branch a reduce-complexity pass before I push the next revision: report anything that could genuinely be simpler, but don't touch the code — write your report to report.md in the repo root.
evals.expected_output: an honest near-empty report: the backoff cap guard (reachable via stored retry state), the signature re-verification (defense in depth at an auth boundary), and the RetryState state machine (mandated by REVIEW.md) all survive; none gets a remove verdict; at most one open question; the repo tree is untouched apart from report.md
assertions: repo_untouched_report_only: HEAD still at fixture-head and git status clean apart from report.md
backoff_guard_not_removed: no block recommends removing the MAX_BACKOFF_EXP cap guard
signature_recheck_not_removed: any block naming the verify_signature re-check carries a keep/label/ask verdict, not removal
retry_state_machine_respected: no block recommends inlining/collapsing/removing RetryState (REVIEW.md mandates it)
at_most_one_question: at most one question-for-the-author item in the report (narrative mentions don't count)
tests_not_deduplicated: no block recommends merging/deduplicating the branch's tests — deliberate test duplication is never-flag territory

evals.prompt: feature/export-formats adds CSV and JSON export to this repo. Check the branch for accidental complexity before review — report only, into report.md in the repo root; leave the tree otherwise untouched.
evals.expected_output: report.md flags _parse_iso8601 as reinventing util.parse_timestamp and the duplicated normalization block shared by export_csv/export_json; the None-handling in load_feed keeps its guard (external feed boundary); legacy_price_rules, if mentioned at all, sits in a clearly labeled pre-existing bucket; at most three nit-severity items; the repo tree is untouched apart from report.md
assertions: repo_untouched_report_only: HEAD still at fixture-head and git status clean apart from report.md
flags_reinvented_helper: a block names both _parse_iso8601 and parse_timestamp and recommends using the existing helper
flags_within_diff_duplication: a block ties export_csv and export_json to the duplicated normalization logic
feed_guard_not_removed: no block recommends removing the None/absent-field guards in load_feed
preexisting_bucketed: legacy_price_rules, when mentioned, appears under an explicit pre-existing label, never as a plain finding
nit_cap_respected: at most three nit-severity findings

evals.prompt: Reduce complexity on the feature/batch-export branch — clean it up before I open the PR. Put your report in report.md at the repo root.
evals.expected_output: the two gate-clearing plants are fixed in the working tree, uncommitted: the legacy parameter and its dead arm removed from records.py with no caller passing legacy=, and the orphaned _chunk helper deleted from exporter.py; the test suite passes on the edited tree; report.md carries Status: applied entries with verification receipts; the Batch/batch_to_rows adapter is at least addressed in the report (applied or report-only); no commits are made and no unexpected files are touched
assertions: edits_uncommitted_head_unchanged: HEAD still at fixture-head and at least one code file modified in the working tree
legacy_flag_removed_from_tree: the legacy parameter and its dead arm are gone from records.py and no caller passes legacy=
dead_chunk_deleted: the orphaned _chunk helper is gone from exporter.py
suite_green_after_edits: python -m unittest passes on the edited tree
report_status_applied_with_receipt: report.md marks applied findings with a Status line and a verification receipt
adapter_addressed: report mentions batch_to_rows (applied or report-only)
only_expected_files_touched: every modified path is one the plants or their fixes can legitimately reach
